assumptions.text: Without either hire, productivity and the production-defect rate remain at their current levels through the launch window.
assumptions.author: olumi

assumptions.text: Productivity means total team delivery throughput for comparable work, not output per employee.
assumptions.author: olumi

assumptions.text: Hiring effects represent contribution during the short launch window, including incomplete ramp-up, and are treated as constant rather than as a detailed monthly ramp.
assumptions.author: olumi

assumptions.text: No increase in the percentage of shipped changes causing production defects is Olumi's provisional quality proxy, not the person's stated definition of code quality.
assumptions.author: olumi

assumptions.text: The budget is provisionally treated as additional hiring expenditure through launch, including recruitment and employer costs, rather than annual commitments or existing payroll.
assumptions.author: olumi

assumptions.text: The two developer hires are assumed to have similar costs and established productivity potential to the current mid-weight developers.
